title: Until I Meet My Husband
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A one-volume manga adaptation of gay activist Ryousuke Nanasaki's memoir essays about his 'firsts' as a young gay man in Japan: school crushes, an oblivious roommate, coming out, his mother's angry reaction, a relationship that ends over jealousy, finding community, and eventually marrying another man.
life_message: Being honest about who you are, and persevering through heartbreak and rejection, can lead to love and a family of your own.
